name: Yuki Nonaka
source:
I have known Yuki since early childhood. As well as her sister [url=https://vndb.org/c156079]Kurumi[/url]. We were very close, but after the day [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]I[/url] saved her, I was exiled from the Village along with [url=https://vndb.org/c152960]Jin[/url]. Luckily, we met again, and now she has become much more attractive. I definitely know that she loves to eat delicious food. Especially when I cook for her.
